name: Caramels
subtitle: By Aunt Kristen
notes: Consider dipping in chocolate and sprinkling with coarse salt.

items: 1 can Eagle Brand (sweetened and condensed milk)

steps.title: Melt the sugar and butter
steps.body: Melt in large heavy pan: **2⅓ cups brown sugar**, **1 cup butter** and a dash of salt.

steps.title: Add the syrup and milk
steps.body: Stir in **1 cup light corn syrup** and **1 can Eagle Brand (sweetened and condensed milk)**.

steps.title: Add the vanilla
steps.body: Remove from heat. Add **1 tsp vanilla** and nuts (optional).

steps.title: Pour and cool
steps.body: Pour in a buttered 9×13 pan. Cool.

steps.title: Cut and wrap
steps.body: Cut. Serve or wrap in wax paper.
